summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buyback transactions for August 31 to September 4, 2026, under a program announced May 20, 2025. The company purchased for cancellation 208,945 ordinary shares at an average price near EUR 23 and 151,288 ordinary shares underlying ADSs at an average price near US$27.40. All shares are cancelled; disclosures follow EU Regulation 596/2014. The filing is a routine periodic buyback update, not an event-driven special situation. What to watch: continued weekly announcements and trajectory against the existing buyback program.
